dedupe_keys.name: mirca bc usmx bias corrected irrigated and planted fractions for the united states and mexico 6 km

description: MIRCA-BC-USMX gives a mean annual cycle of monthly planted and irrigated fractions at 0.0625 degree (about 6 km) over the continental United States and Mexico for 1992, 2002 and 2012. The Zenodo record says the fractions reconcile MIRCA2000 with the 2001 cropland and pasture classes of a harmonized NLCD and INEGI land cover, then bias-correct to state totals from USDA and Mexican government records, and are added to Variable Infiltration Capacity (VIC 5.1) model parameter files with an irrigation module. It was published in April 2019 by Theodore Bohn and Enrique Vivoni as a research team output under the CC BY 4.0 licence, free to download as NetCDF parameter and fraction files with county and municipality code grids. Coverage is the United States and Mexico. Caveats: fractions are a mean annual cycle for three years, not a time series. For simulation it gives irrigation and planting inputs for VIC hydrology runs of drought, irrigation demand and water supply stress across agricultural regions. Related catalogue records include MIRCA2000 and the USGS subsurface tile drainage extent.
